_how_to_use: Real-life knowledge the numbers can't see yet. Keys are FPL player ids (names repeat across clubs) or names; team keys are FPL short names. Values are a number or {"<gw>": value} (holds until the next listed GW). attack_mult scales a team's goals scored; defence_mult scales goals CONCEDED (above 1 = leakier). Every entry needs a dated reason; keys starting with _ are ignored. Only add what xG can't already see. 'market' = bookmaker expected goals per fixture for one GW, 'HOME-AWAY': [home goals, away goals]; blended in at 70% and replaces team multipliers for those fixtures.
